args.description: A small modular UI board FRAME construction kit for a dwarven excavation mine, crisp native pixel art, front-on orthographic view, all pieces separate on transparency. Arrange one square 27-pixel corner plate with a small luminous AMBER DIAMOND securely inset in a chamfered forged-iron socket, a horizontal dark timber rail, a vertical timber rail, and a small square riveted connector bracket. Sturdy chunky hand-built mining machine structure. Warm brown timber, charcoal purple-gray iron planes, restrained copper rivets, small orange/yellow crystal facets. Simple connected 2-3 tone material clusters, dark clean contour, controlled top-left highlights, no texture noise, no gradients or anti-aliasing, no text, no characters, no scenery, no full frame, no drills. The wooden rails are narrow and straight, iron straps attach cleanly across their centerline. All forms fully inside canvas with transparent gaps. Mobile match-3 fantasy UI, charming but premium, strong readable silhouettes and economical highlights. Crystal socket more prominent than tiny bolt accents. Keep the large quiet timber planes clearly visible.

decision: Candidate 1: fitted mechanical socket and timber rails. Native reconstruction of 27px corners/9px rails to preserve frame geometry. Other candidates retained unselected.
